title: Workspace mutation result and workspace change

workspaceChange.description: The facts a workspace settings or visibility write changed, as the daemon wrote them. Applied over the snapshot record with the same workspace_id (or previous_workspace_id); the other fields of that record are kept.

previous_workspace_id.description: Present when the first settings write gave the workspace a durable ID.

icon_commit.description: An icon write's outcome in Git: committed (a commit of .open-habitat.yaml alone, not pushed), unchanged (the config already said it), not_git (a plain directory: only the file), uncommitted (the config had other changes, so the written file is left for the person), commit_failed (Git refused; the file is written). The new icon comes in the next snapshot.

event_cursor.description: The journal position of the workspace.changed event this write published. A snapshot whose event_cursor has passed it already contains the change.
